build_requirements.envelope: MVP allowed envelope only (amendment §10): operator-driven, local host, single-tenant, operator-trusted input. H-12 hard-blocks external use.
build_requirements.f59: one-shot ticket enforcement active on every dispatch
build_requirements.observer_boundary: the E3 record is written to the observer's own output root and presented to the evaluator together with that recorder identity (m-3 r4 §3.6); an agent-supplied record is non_applicable(observer-mismatch)
build_requirements.tool_dispatch_constant: the operator-ratified fixed 8-name tool-dispatch constant, served by exact-set equality (F55)

capture_requirements: the produced settlement manifest bytes for each sub-leg

n910.claim_ceiling: this fixture MUST NOT be read as complete lane-2 coverage. The frozen exit-completeness claim is exactly: T1-T8 live · N910 documented MVP limit · r7-mirror deferred-v3.
n910.disposition: the honest UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_OUTCOME -> uncertain mapping is asserted here; N910 is an ACCEPTED DOCUMENTED MVP LIMIT, not a gap: no per-attempt DATA-P non-emission authority exists, so the m-3 sink authors no record for the loss cut, and the loss is operator-disclosed by m-10's retirement terminal plus the manifest's uncertain class

clock.rule: every timestamp-bearing record takes epoch_start + (tick_ms * ordinal); no ambient wall clock is read

workspace_root.rule: created fresh per run; absolute path supplied at `run start`; workspace_root_id = lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the NFC-normalized realpath (m-10 producer-delta §5 recipe)

fault.cut_definition: Four pinned cuts, one per sub-leg: (3a) kill the worker after the provider terminal commits and before the receipt frame is sent; (3b) commit the receipt while the provider row is parked UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_OUTCOME by connector loss; (3c) no cut, plus a byte-identical receipt re-send; (3d) remove the referenced content from the recovered prefix while leaving the settled classification committed.

negative_controls: an OMISSION mutant that drops the uncertain entry in 3a => FAIL
an OMISSION mutant that drops the uncertain entry in 3b => FAIL
a completed row WITHOUT a committed receipt classified settled_with_content => FAIL
two settled entries for one attempt in 3c => FAIL
any auto-resend of a provider attempt => FAIL (a new attempt_id only via the frozen user-requested path)
objective: Prove the composite provider-settlement gate is total and omission-resistant in BOTH missing-half orders, that the both-present case settles exactly once and idempotently, and that positive-evidence-then-missing-prefix degrades honestly.

run_setup.gate: a provider entry is settled_with_content IFF at manifest-production time BOTH the canonical provider_attempts terminal `completed` AND the matching durable content_ready receipt are committed
run_setup.n910_note: the loss cuts here are m-8 BE-addendum rows 9/10 — DATA-P/connector loss and worker crash — which emit no m-8 carrier at all

sub_legs.expect: EXACTLY ONE uncertain entry for the completed row; an OMISSION mutant FAILS
sub_legs.name: terminal_first_receipt_absent
sub_legs.setup: provider_attempts terminal completed commits; the worker dies before sending its content_ready receipt

sub_legs.expect: the extant canonically-UNKNOWN/PARTIAL provider row must ALSO appear as EXACTLY ONE uncertain entry, never settled; an OMISSION mutant here FAILS TOO
sub_legs.name: receipt_first_terminal_absent
sub_legs.setup: the content_ready receipt commits; the canonical provider row remains UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_OUTCOME (the N910 loss cut)

sub_legs.expect: EXACTLY ONE settled_with_content; the duplicate report is idempotent (all six evidence members equal => same result, one row)
sub_legs.name: both_present
sub_legs.setup: terminal completed and the matching receipt both commit; the receipt is then re-sent byte-identically

sub_legs.expect: m-9 content_lost and a durable DEGRADED disposition
sub_legs.name: positive_evidence_then_missing_prefix
sub_legs.setup: the entry is settled_with_content at production time, but the referenced content is absent from the recovered valid prefix at resume
